dataset.title: NASS Quick Stats — published US agricultural estimates
dataset.description: Original USDA agricultural estimates and census query results; a planned source for evidence-based agricultural Newswire editions, not a cached or sold 561 dataset.
dataset.measurementUnit: per-row unit_desc; never assume a constant physical unit

rights.attribution: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS); original dataset and observed edition
rights.provenanceRequirements: Retain origin and edition; distinguish public facts from API terms and third-party exceptions; review dataset-specific rights before commercial publication.
